basic_info.description: Prime Marina District Location! Bright & Sunny Two-Bedroom 1.5 Bath Condominium located a half block from the Palace of Fine Arts. Sun-drenched lower flat offers the perfect blend of Mediterranean detail combined with modern conveniences. The refined interior showcases beautifully refinished hardwood floors, period detail, a wood-burning fireplace and stylish light fixtures. The south-facing living room receives sunlight throughout the day creating a warm and inviting ambiance. The kitchen has been nicely updated and features mosaic tile, soapstone countertops and stainless steel appliances. Designed for both comfort and efficiency, the kitchen features a breakfast island and open-concept that flows nicely to the formal dining room. This home includes 1.5 baths and convenient in-unit laundry with full size stackable machines. Both bedrooms are located at the rear of the building and overlook an expansive rear garden. The garage level offers one car parking and a private storage room (9 x 12).
